title: JD.com Food Delivery Launches AI Smart Helmet: The Familiar Map of Experienced Riders is Installed in the Ears. First Batch of Riders Can Get It Free
excerpt: JD.com's delivery service has officially launched an AI smart helmet, which will be freely distributed to full-time riders first and gradually opened to all rid
content_html:
JD.com's delivery service has officially launched an AI smart helmet, which will be freely distributed to full-time riders first and gradually opened to all riders. This helmet is equipped with an AI voice assistant, built-in "Single King Route" navigation, and can automatically interpret order notes, reminding riders in advance before delivery.

Three Core Scenarios: Hands-free in the Rain, Navigating Labyrinth-like Communities, Automatic Recognition of Notes

The AI smart helmet addresses the three most painful scenarios for delivery riders. To tackle the difficulty of using a phone in the rain, the helmet supports full-process voice interaction — riders just need to speak to complete tasks like accepting orders and calling users, keeping their hands on the handlebars at all times. Rider Xiao Zhang from Beijing fears "labyrinth-like communities," where building numbers are hidden behind trees and entrances are deep inside, making a trip take several minutes of circling. The "Single King Route" built into the helmet brings the experience of veteran riders' "living maps" into the algorithm, providing precise guidance through audio prompts such as "Go straight from the south gate, turn left at the white statue, and the second building is the destination."

Secondly, the helmet can recognize order notes — for example, mother Li Jie from Shanghai notes "the child is sleeping, please put it at the door" on every order, but often worries that riders might miss it. The AI helmet will proactively remind riders to check the note before delivering, ensuring no instruction is forgotten. In addition, the helmet is equipped with a "Merchant Environment Verification" feature, assisting riders in verifying the store environment when picking up food, and automatically marking any issues.

From receiving an order to completing the delivery, the entire workflow for delivery riders is being reconnected by AI. When the experience of veteran riders no longer relies on oral transmission between mentors and apprentices, but is directly embedded into each helmet, the most traditional food delivery is being quietly rewritten at its core logic.

content_html_zh:
京东配送服务正式推出AI智能头盔，将首先向全职骑手免费发放，并逐步向所有骑手开放。 这款头盔配备AI语音助手，内置“单王路线”导航，并能自动解读订单备注，在发货前提前提醒骑手。

三大核心场景：雨中免提、迷宫社区、自动识别笔记

AI智能头盔解决了外卖骑手最痛苦的三个场景。 为了解决雨中打电话的困难，头盔支持全流程语音交互，骑手只需要说话即可完成接受订单、呼叫用户等任务，双手始终放在车把上。 来自北京的骑手小张担心“迷宫般的社区”，那里的建筑门牌号隐藏在树后，入口在内部深处，绕一圈需要几分钟。 头盔内置的“单王路线”将老骑手的“活地图”经验带入算法中，通过“从南门直走，到白色雕像处左转，第二栋楼就是目的地”等音频提示提供精准引导。

其次，头盔可以识别订单备注——例如，来自上海的妈妈李洁在每张订单上都会注明“孩子正在睡觉，请放在门口”，但常常担心骑手会错过。 AI头盔会主动提醒骑手在送货前检查票据，确保不会忘记指令。 此外，头盔还配备了“商户环境验证”功能，协助骑手在取餐时验证商户环境，如有问题会自动标记。

从接到订单到完成配送，外卖骑手的整个工作流程正在被人工智能重新连接起来。 当老骑手的经验不再依赖师徒之间的口头传递，而是直接嵌入到每个头盔中时，最传统的送餐方式正在悄然改写其核心逻辑。
